verdict.rationale: Secureframe documents a vendor tab with vendor profiles, risk assessments, document attachments and history logs (docs-81). It also covers continuous tracking of vendors' security posture (docs-39), recurring reviews scheduled by risk level with Jira/Slack tasks (docs-8), and SSO-based shadow-IT detection that keeps the vendor inventory current (docs-11). Comply AI extracts security-review answers from vendor SOC 2 reports (docs-24), which replaces spreadsheet-based vendor reviews. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of tracking each vendor's data access/data types, independent or hands-on corroboration of the vendor risk workflow.
